epics.title: Employee Document Dossier and Report Generation
epics.jtbd: When reviewing an employee's history, I want to find all their related documents and generate a summary report, so that I have a complete view of their activity and status.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time spent assembling an employee dossier from manual search time to under 10 seconds
epics.tocConstraintRef: administrative overhead in HR document aggregation
requirements: R1: Filter existing documents (orders, academic council extracts, reports, exams) by specific employee or surname.
R2: Display a consolidated list of the filtered documents for viewing.
R3: Generate a unified summary report based on a predefined template for the selected employee.
R4: Display clear error feedback if report generation fails, allowing the user to retry or adjust the query.
R5: Provide initial sample content with at least one employee and related documents to exercise the path on a fresh install.

slices.title: Data schema for employee document aggregation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the data layer for this epic, I want to define the schema and queries to group disparate documents by employee, so that the dossier generation has a unified data source.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an employee ID, when querying for related documents, then the system returns a unified set of orders, reports, and exams.
Given a missing employee, when querying, then it returns an empty set.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce document aggregation query latency to under 200ms

slices.title: API contract for dossier search and report generation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the shared API for this epic, I want to define the contract for searching documents and requesting reports, so that frontend and backend can be built in parallel.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the API contract requirement, when the definition is completed, then an OpenAPI spec is committed detailing the search and report endpoints.
Given the payload definitions, when validated, then they cover all required fields for document lists.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce contract-related integration defects to zero

slices.title: Backend API for dossier search and report generation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backend for this epic, I want to expose endpoints to fetch documents and generate summary reports, so that the frontend can consume them.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the API contract, when a search request is made, then the backend returns the correct document list.
Given a report generation request, when processed, then the backend successfully generates and returns the report file.
Given the acceptance floor, when the system starts, then initial sample content for employees and documents is populated.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: ensure report generation succeeds in >99% of valid requests

slices.title: Frontend interface for employee dossier and reports
slices.jtbd: When implementing the UI for this epic, I want to build a search interface and document list, so that users can view dossiers and download reports.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user on a mobile or desktop device, when they search for an employee, then they see a list of documents and their typed search term survives.
Given the document list, when they click generate report, then they see visible loading feedback until the report is downloaded.
slices.tocConstraintRef: user friction in finding and compiling employee info
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to visually locate and download an employee report to under 5 seconds

slices.title: QA coverage for employee dossier and report generation
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to write E2E and integration tests, so that the dossier and report generation features are verified against regressions.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the test suite, when the E2E tests run, then they verify that an employee can be searched and their documents displayed.
Given the report endpoint, when tested, then it verifies a report is generated successfully based on the initial sample content.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: achieve 100% automated test coverage of the dossier search and report critical paths

epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase successful registration and first-login completion rate from unknown to 95%
epics.tocConstraintRef: friction in onboarding new employees blocking their system access
requirements: R1: Provide a clear registration form for new employees.
R2: Place an obvious and accessible login link in the system header.
R3: Implement a smooth user onboarding flow for newly registered users.
R4: Provide a self-service recovery path for locked-out accounts.

slices.title: UI/UX Design for registration, login, and onboarding
slices.jtbd: When implementing design for this epic, I want to create clear mockups for registration, login, and recovery, so that the engineering team has a verified blueprint.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the need for a registration flow, when the design is completed, then an HTML/CSS mockup is committed showing clear registration, login header, and onboarding.
Given the quality floor, when reviewed, then the design includes mobile layouts and visible feedback states for all actions.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: ensure 100% of critical auth paths are covered in the mockup

slices.title: API contract for authentication and onboarding
slices.jtbd: When implementing the shared API for this epic, I want to define the contract for registration, login, and account recovery, so that backend and frontend can develop concurrently.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the design mockups, when the API is designed, then the contract defines endpoints for registration, login, and password recovery.
Given the contract, when validated, then both frontend and backend teams agree on the payload structures.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce contract-related integration defects to zero

slices.title: Backend API for registration, login, and recovery
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backend for this epic, I want to build the auth and recovery endpoints, so that users can securely register and log in.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the API contract, when a valid registration is submitted, then a new user is created securely.
Given an account recovery request, when submitted, then the backend initiates a secure self-service recovery flow.
slices.tocConstraintRef: security and state management in auth
slices.sixSigmaMetric: ensure 100% of successful registrations are securely hashed and stored

slices.title: Frontend interface for registration and onboarding
slices.jtbd: When implementing the UI for this epic, I want to build the registration form, header link, and onboarding steps, so that users have a smooth entry into the system.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the login header and registration form, when a user interacts with them on mobile, then they provide visible feedback and preserve typed input on error.
Given a newly registered user, when they log in, then they are guided through a smooth onboarding flow.
slices.tocConstraintRef: user drop-off during registration and first login
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to complete registration and onboarding to under 2 minutes

slices.title: QA coverage for registration and onboarding
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to write tests for the auth and onboarding flows, so that users can reliably access the system.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the test suite, when the E2E tests run, then they verify a user can register, see the onboarding flow, and log out.
Given the recovery feature, when tested, then it verifies a locked-out account can successfully be recovered.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: achieve 100% automated test coverage of the registration and recovery critical paths
